subject: Speaker slot: security track, 14 January
body:
Hi Jana,

We are putting together the security track for our January conference in Munich and your talks on AI-driven phishing came up more than once. Would you be open to a 25-minute keynote slot on 14 January?

The speaker brief has the dates, the other panellists and the audience numbers: speaker brief.

Happy to work around your December travel.

Best,
Lena Hofer
Programme, EventCrew Munich
